course_name: 數位信號處理器應用技術
outline: 數位信號處理簡介，DSP架構簡介(以德儀的TMS320C系列為基礎)， DSP作伺服馬達及運動控制之應用與實習。
schedule:
Theory
Week1 Lec1: Introduction
Week2 Lec2: Discrete Signals and Systems
Week3 Lec3: Discrete Time Fourier Transform
Week4 Lec4: Z-Transform
Week5 Lec5: Discrete Fourier Transform and Fast Fourier Transform
Week6 Lec6: FIR Filter Design
Week7 Lec7: IIR Filter Design
Week8 Lec8: Implementation Issues
Week9 Midterm Exam
Week10 Lec9: DSP Hardware
Week11 Lec10: ADCs for DSP Applications
Week12 Lec11: DACs for DSP Applications
Week13 Lec12: Hardware Design Techniques
Laboratory
Week14 Lab1 Code Composer CCS
Week15 Lab2 Digital Output on Port E with a GPT2 –period & Digital Input Port B
Week16 Lab3 Two Channel Analogue Conversion & PWM signal with variable duty-cycle
Week17 Lab4 Final Project
Week18 Final Exam
assessment:
Homework: 5%*8, Experiment Reports: 5%+10%+10%
Midterm Report: 15%, Final Project: 20%
materials:
